blocks.text: TORONTO — Kawhi Leonard is not expected to play when Toronto visits the Los Angeles Clippers next week, after the Raptors announced Tuesday that the veteran forward will be sidelined for at least a week because of swelling in his left knee. Leonard, who has a long history of knee problems, will be reevaluated in a week and is undergoing “a treatment and rehabilitation program to address swelling,” the Raptors said.
